scenes.title: The broken cart
scenes.staging: Training Grounds exit approach; Nera, Roan, Yuufa, player. A cart tilts beside the road. Rescue tutorial uses ordinary weak monsters; no lethal timed failure.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
text: Please tell me you are the rescue party.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: We are a party. The rescue part is new.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: Then we should start before the cart notices.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Who is still missing?
Tell me where to help.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
text: The driver. And a parcel with a blue cord. Driver first. Please.

dialogue.speaker: After rescue, Driver
text: I thought you would take the parcel and leave.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: You were considerably louder than the parcel.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
text: It contains missing-person reports. Someone has been collecting the originals.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Nera: 'Please tell me you are the rescue party.'
Roan: 'We are a party. The rescue part is new.'
Yuufa: 'Then we should start before the cart notices.'
Player choices: 'Who is still missing?' / 'Tell me where to help.'
Nera: 'The driver. And a parcel with a blue cord. Driver first. Please.'
After rescue, Driver: 'I thought you would take the parcel and leave.'
Yuufa: 'You were considerably louder than the parcel.'
Nera: 'It contains missing-person reports. Someone has been collecting the originals.'

Objective: rescue the driver, recover the parcel, speak to Nera. Completion requires both people and parcel; no reward for choosing property over a life.

scenes.title: What you choose to become
scenes.staging: Prontera guild-office anteroom; Hald, player, early companions. Complete the authentic first-job quest before this scene closes.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: A job is not a costume. You will learn its discipline, advance within it, and live with its limits.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: And discover which limits are yours to change.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: I understand. This is my path.
I need more time.

dialogue.speaker: If more time, Hald
text: Good. A considered answer is cheaper than a lifelong mistake.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: Then I will trust you to choose where we stand.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: Then show me what I cannot see from behind a shield.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: Then I will listen when you tell me we cannot keep pushing.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: The reports lead to Payon. You are not commissioned to solve a kingdom's problems. You are commissioned to deliver a parcel.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
text: And perhaps ask why every copy has a different name.

dialogue.speaker: UI before confirmation
text: Your job lineage and story role become permanent in normal play. Promotions and rebirth remain available within that lineage.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Hald: 'A job is not a costume. You will learn its discipline, advance within it, and live with its limits.'
Yuufa: 'And discover which limits are yours to change.'
Player choices: 'I understand. This is my path.' / 'I need more time.'
If more time, Hald: 'Good. A considered answer is cheaper than a lifelong mistake.'
V — Roan: 'Then I will trust you to choose where we stand.'
P — Roan: 'Then show me what I cannot see from behind a shield.'
K — Roan: 'Then I will listen when you tell me we cannot keep pushing.'
Hald: 'The reports lead to Payon. You are not commissioned to solve a kingdom's problems. You are commissioned to deliver a parcel.'
Nera: 'And perhaps ask why every copy has a different name.'

UI before confirmation: 'Your job lineage and story role become permanent in normal play. Promotions and rebirth remain available within that lineage.' A second clear confirmation applies to the job, not an accidental dialogue click.

scenes.title: The first watch
scenes.staging: South-field camp; Roan, Yuufa, player.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: Do you think a real adventurer knows when they have started?

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: Usually when the bill arrives.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: We started when we went back for the driver.
Ask me after Payon.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: Then let us make one rule. If someone falls behind, we notice.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: And if noticing is inconvenient?

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: We go back.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Roan: 'Do you think a real adventurer knows when they have started?'
Yuufa: 'Usually when the bill arrives.'

Yuufa: 'And if noticing is inconvenient?'
Player: 'We go back.'

Roan and Yuufa offer to accompany the player. Their combat coverage complements the selected route. End chapter with a visible journal destination, not a forced unexplained warp.

scenes.title: Two names for one grave
scenes.staging: Payon outskirts; Judia, Nera, player. Regional anchor: accessible Payon haunting/ancestral quest material following dependency audit.

dialogue.speaker: Judia
text: That marker said something else yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
text: Weather can take paint off wood. It cannot rewrite the receipt in my pocket.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Who remembers the person?
Let us compare the records.

dialogue.speaker: Judia
text: His daughter does. Today. That is why I would prefer we hurry.

dialogue.speaker: Judia
text: You keep the search road open. I will follow the tracks.

dialogue.speaker: Judia
text: Two sets of eyes. Let us see which one the liar forgot.

dialogue.speaker: Judia
text: Stay with the family while we work. Tell them what we know, not what we hope.

Objective: complete the selected local investigation and preserve two independent testimonies. The daughter is not erased on a real-world timer.

scenes.title: An excellent charitable investment
scenes.staging: Alberta warehouse; Maya, Veyr, player.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
text: Relief supplies do not generally need armed guards facing inward.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: The guards protect the records from theft. Their contents are irreplaceable.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: People are irreplaceable too.
Who authorized these shipments?

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: Of course. Records are how we find people when the world loses them.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
text: Then your invoices should help us find the missing driver.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: You may examine them. I would rather have suspicious helpers than incurious ones.

scenes.fullSceneText:

He genuinely supplies useful information. Do not use villain music or a secret-camera smirk: his philosophy should become dangerous through choices, not an obvious introduction.

scenes.title: A name of our own
scenes.staging: Alberta inn table; Roan, Yuufa, Judia, Maya, player.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
text: If we keep sharing expenses, I require a name for the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: Something heroic.

dialogue.speaker: Judia
text: Something short enough to shout while running.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: Something the missing might recognize when we come looking.

dialogue.speaker: Maya, after confirmation
text: {GUILD}. Good. Now it exists in two ledgers and one exceptionally untidy heart.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: We make room for people who need us.
We finish what we begin.

dialogue.speaker: Judia
text: Then I am staying. Someone should make sure you notice the tracks.

Judia: 'Then I am staying. Someone should make sure you notice the tracks.'

Guild is a solo narrative organization, not implementation of WoE or multiplayer guild infrastructure. Naming never consumes a rare normal-game guild item unless explicitly decided later.

scenes.title: The theorem and the witness
scenes.staging: Geffen library; Takius, Pip, player.

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: A memory cannot simply be stolen. It must be displaced, suppressed, or destroyed.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
text: Mine was in the parcel. I forgot the address while I was carrying it.

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: That is not quite what I—

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Listen to what happened.
Can we test it without hurting anyone?

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: Yes. And I owe our witness a better first question.

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: Keep the chamber clear while I measure the interference.

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: Find the changing symbol before I tell you which one I expect.

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: Watch the witness, not the apparatus. Stop me if the experiment costs them anything.

scenes.fullSceneText:

A bounded observation puzzle and local quest lead reveal the first anchor signature. No mandatory blind guess or external reference.

scenes.title: Harbor orders
scenes.staging: Izlude quay; Brann, Hald, player. Defend evacuation paths during a shipment attack.

dialogue.speaker: Brann
text: My orders say keep the cargo on the pier.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
text: The cargo is on fire.

dialogue.speaker: Brann
text: I am revising my interpretation.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: I will hold the gangway. Move them behind me.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: The signalers are directing the attack. Cover me while I stop them.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: Bring the injured to the shelter. We leave nobody on that pier.

dialogue.speaker: Hald, afterward
text: Your report will mention the supplies lost.

dialogue.speaker: Brann
text: Then make room for the names of everyone who lived.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: I have.

scenes.title: The door stays open
scenes.staging: Guild's provisional room; core four and player.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: We cannot invite everyone in danger to come with us.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: No. But we can stop pretending that leaving them somewhere is the same as making them safe.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
text: I found a landlord willing to accept repairs instead of the first payment.

dialogue.speaker: Judia
text: What is wrong with the roof?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
text: Its most affordable feature is the absence of one.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Then we start with the roof.
And a door that opens from the inside.

Unlock a simple guild-hall scene location, not an expensive construction simulator. Brann, Takius and Pip can now join through their roster conversations.

scenes.title: A transaction without a seller
scenes.staging: Morroc market; Iruga, Kest, player.

text: I stole a manifest. Before anyone becomes moral, somebody had already stolen the people on it.

dialogue.speaker: Iruga
text: They were listed as volunteers.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Where are they now?
Who recorded their consent?

dialogue.speaker: Iruga
text: That is the question the guards were ordered not to ask.

dialogue.speaker: Iruga
text: We need a visible escort. Let them see whom they are following.

dialogue.speaker: Iruga
text: Find the transport route. The empty wagons return by another road.

dialogue.speaker: Iruga
text: Some will not trust a rescue. Give them a choice that remains a choice.

scenes.title: The name below the stone
scenes.staging: Pyramid chamber; player, Iruga, Takius, Witness fragment.

dialogue.speaker: Witness

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: Who are you?

dialogue.speaker: Witness
text: That was the price.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: You do not have to remember to deserve help.
Tell us what you can.

dialogue.speaker: Witness
text: A white room. A northern train. A man who would not call it a prison.

dialogue.speaker: Iruga
text: Then we have a direction.

Disable an anchor through combat and a readable interaction sequence. The fragment survives as a carried story state, not a permanently loaded effect or follower.

scenes.title: The thing an apology cannot do
scenes.staging: Desert camp; Iruga, player.

dialogue.speaker: Iruga
text: I guarded a road like that once. I did not ask where it ended.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Then ask now, and act on the answer.
An apology does not bring them back.

dialogue.speaker: Iruga
text: No. It does not.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: Will you help the people still there?

dialogue.speaker: Iruga
text: Yes. Whether you let me stay or not.

Player: 'Will you help the people still there?'
Iruga: 'Yes. Whether you let me stay or not.'

The player may recruit or decline him without losing the campaign. His accountability continues in later rescue work; forgiveness is not awarded by a single menu response.

scenes.staging: Al De Baran relief depot; Hald, Maya, Oren, player.

text: The same bridge has been repaired in three different budgets.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: It has only been repaired once.

dialogue.speaker: Oren

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Follow the money.
First make sure the next convoy gets through.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: Escort the workers through. We need a road, not another heroic ruin.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: Identify the ambush points before the convoy leaves.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: Organize supplies and a fallback shelter. We can survive a delay; they cannot survive wishful thinking.

Clock Tower and relief-road quest anchors connect funding irregularities to the northern network. No arbitrary demand to complete unrelated regional quests.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: Authorize protection for the witnesses. Release the impounded supplies. Put my name on the order.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
text: An apology with an inventory. My favorite kind.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: Do not make me regret including the good canvas.

The coalition becomes tangible: relief NPCs and scene dialogue acknowledge completed aid. Suri, Oren, Lale and Daro have recruitment opportunities; no four-AI requirement.

scenes.staging: Remote projection in an abandoned lab; Veyr, Takius, player.

text: Every village loses people and calls it inevitable. Every war burns records and calls it history. I can end that.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: By taking their choices?
You cannot restore people by imprisoning what remains.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: Freedom is a small comfort to someone nobody remembers.

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: So you made certain they could not refuse your comfort.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: I made certain the next disaster would not have the final word.

scenes.staging: Regional dispatch meeting, Amatsu; Kaede, Edda, player.

Select three findings from four sources to avoid one broken side chain blocking the whole game; the journal names alternatives explicitly.

scenes.staging: Guild dispatch room; Edda, Kaede, player.

dialogue.speaker: Edda
text: I could publish the entire method. Nobody could bury it again.

dialogue.speaker: Kaede
text: And the next Veyr would not need to begin his research.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Publish the evidence and safeguards. Restrict the dangerous procedure.
Let the communities decide with us.

dialogue.speaker: Edda
text: Then the final page cannot be mine alone.

Both choices lead to consultation, with different immediate dispatch text. This is not a binary good/evil meter. Edda and Kaede's personal resolutions become available.

text: Then we remember that we possess feet and judgment.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: We came to listen, not to collect anyone.
How do we return?

dialogue.speaker: Miri
text: Together, with permission where permission is possible, and without pretending that every door should stay open.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Miri: 'If you hear a voice you miss, do not promise to follow it anywhere.'
Haneul: 'And if the stars point down?'
Miri: 'Then we remember that we possess feet and judgment.'
Player choices: 'We came to listen, not to collect anyone.' / 'How do we return?'
Miri: 'Together, with permission where permission is possible, and without pretending that every door should stay open.'

Use the existing access progression and safe-return rules. No real-world disappearance timer or surprise loss of a beloved save character.

scenes.title: The Witness speaks
scenes.staging: Quiet Niflheim room; Witness, Yuufa, player.

dialogue.speaker: Witness
text: We remember being wanted. We remember being afraid. He tells us these are the same memory.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: They are not.

dialogue.speaker: Witness
text: If you free us, some of us will stop speaking.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: That choice should be yours.
Tell us what you want before we act.

dialogue.speaker: Witness
text: We want him to hear us say no.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: Then I will keep the way open while you say it.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: Then I will find the channel he cannot silence.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: Then I will help you speak without holding you here.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Witness: 'We remember being wanted. We remember being afraid. He tells us these are the same memory.'
Yuufa: 'They are not.'
Witness: 'If you free us, some of us will stop speaking.'
Player choices: 'That choice should be yours.' / 'Tell us what you want before we act.'
Witness: 'We want him to hear us say no.'
V — Player: 'Then I will keep the way open while you say it.'
P — Player: 'Then I will find the channel he cannot silence.'
K — Player: 'Then I will help you speak without holding you here.'

The Witness consents to one final transmission. This is the emotional and mechanical basis of the final rescue, not a quest item treated as property.

scenes.title: An empty chair
scenes.staging: Guild hall reunion; Yuufa, Roan, player.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: I kept thinking there must be one more prayer.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: Was there?

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: There was a person who needed me to listen instead.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: We do not have to call that failure.
We can remember them without keeping them here.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: Then the chair stays empty tonight. Nobody has to explain it.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Yuufa: 'I kept thinking there must be one more prayer.'
Roan: 'Was there?'
Yuufa: 'There was a person who needed me to listen instead.'
Player choices: 'We do not have to call that failure.' / 'We can remember them without keeping them here.'
Roan: 'Then the chair stays empty tonight. Nobody has to explain it.'

A quiet beat after death imagery. Miri and Haneul can join; the reserve roster sends short personal check-ins.

scenes.title: Begin again
scenes.chapterTitle: The Weight of a New Name
scenes.staging: Rebirth institution or equivalent guild preparation for non-rebirthing classes; player, Fenris, companion appropriate to route.

dialogue.speaker: Fenris
text: A new beginning is not a receipt that cancels the old one.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: I want to carry it better.
I will continue as I am.

dialogue.speaker: Fenris
text: Both answers require work.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: You do not need a grander title for me to trust your back.

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: Changing what we know does not make the earlier questions worthless.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: You are allowed to grow without becoming less kind to who you were.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Fenris: 'A new beginning is not a receipt that cancels the old one.'
Player choices: 'I want to carry it better.' / 'I will continue as I am.'
Fenris: 'Both answers require work.'
V — Roan: 'You do not need a grander title for me to trust your back.'
P — Takius: 'Changing what we know does not make the earlier questions worthless.'
K — Yuufa: 'You are allowed to grow without becoming less kind to who you were.'

Rebirth is optional where class rules require it to be optional. Expanded/Super Novice characters receive an equal narrative preparation milestone, not an impossible transcendent requirement. Existing job quests retain their authentic progression.

scenes.title: A room prepared for someone else
scenes.chapterTitle: The Weight of a New Name
scenes.staging: Rachel/Veins investigation; Iris, player, local quest contact.

dialogue.speaker: Iris
text: They asked me whether a person would return if every memory of them were restored.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: What did you tell them?
Who were they hoping to bring back?

dialogue.speaker: Iris
text: That a remembered answer cannot consent for a living person.

dialogue.speaker: Local contact
text: Veyr has moved the final equipment south. The temples were never his destination.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Iris: 'They asked me whether a person would return if every memory of them were restored.'
Player choices: 'What did you tell them?' / 'Who were they hoping to bring back?'
Iris: 'That a remembered answer cannot consent for a living person.'
Local contact: 'Veyr has moved the final equipment south. The temples were never his destination.'

Rachel/Veins/Ice Dungeon quest anchors reveal that Veyr is trying to restore a family first and a civilization second. Religious NPCs are not flattened into one uniformly corrupt faction.

scenes.title: The letter he never sent
scenes.chapterTitle: The Weight of a New Name
scenes.staging: Safe camp; Nera, player. Find Veyr's unsent letter through investigation rather than stealing private grief as a reward.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
text: He wrote it before the first shipment.

dialogue.speaker: Letter, read by Nera
text: I cannot bear that the world continues to contain so little of you. I am afraid that if I stop, I will have agreed to lose you.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: That grief was real. So were his victims.
We can understand him and still stop him.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
text: I will keep both facts in the record.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Nera: 'He wrote it before the first shipment.'
Letter, read by Nera: 'I cannot bear that the world continues to contain so little of you. I am afraid that if I stop, I will have agreed to lose you.'
Player choices: 'That grief was real. So were his victims.' / 'We can understand him and still stop him.'
Nera: 'I will keep both facts in the record.'

scenes.title: The first anchor burns
scenes.staging: Thor approach; Dagna, Corin, player.

dialogue.speaker: Dagna
text: Those couplings were designed to survive a furnace. They were not designed to survive someone who knows where I cut corners.

dialogue.speaker: Corin
text: For once, your professional shame is excellent news.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: I will keep the Guardians away from the work.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: Mark the exposed couplings. I will break them in sequence.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: Tell me when you need protection. We stop before this becomes another sacrifice.

dialogue.speaker: Dagna
text: Gladly. I am developing standards.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Dagna: 'Those couplings were designed to survive a furnace. They were not designed to survive someone who knows where I cut corners.'
Corin: 'For once, your professional shame is excellent news.'
V — Player: 'I will keep the Guardians away from the work.'
P — Player: 'Mark the exposed couplings. I will break them in sequence.'
K — Player: 'Tell me when you need protection. We stop before this becomes another sacrifice.'
Dagna: 'Gladly. I am developing standards.'

Boss and Guardian balance must be tested with the chosen route; engineering interactions have non-skill-specific equivalents.

scenes.title: A history that fights back
scenes.staging: Abbey/Thanatos arc conclusion; Fenris, Chaos, player, Witness.

dialogue.speaker: Chaos
text: People keep telling me what someone with my name must do.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: What do you choose?
Then help us give these people a different question.

dialogue.speaker: Chaos
text: I can hold the evacuation route. You should finish what you started.

dialogue.speaker: Witness
text: He is listening now. He is angry that we are not grateful.

dialogue.speaker: Fenris
text: Then he has finally heard a voice he did not write.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Chaos: 'People keep telling me what someone with my name must do.'
Player choices: 'What do you choose?' / 'Then help us give these people a different question.'
Chaos: 'I can hold the evacuation route. You should finish what you started.'
Witness: 'He is listening now. He is angry that we are not grateful.'
Fenris: 'Then he has finally heard a voice he did not write.'

Abbey and Thanatos are separate sources of danger and history; do not retcon their native antagonists into Veyr's employees. Their completed discoveries expose the network's last anchor and its disastrous contact with Morroc.

scenes.title: The council with too many chairs
scenes.staging: Guild hall; Hald, Nera, Maya, player; selected roster representatives.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: We can guard the roads. We cannot put an army through that breach.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
text: Then stop calling the small party inadequate and start keeping its return road open.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
text: I have a list of everyone still missing.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Read it before we leave.
Give each rescue team its names.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: Both. We have enough people to do both.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Hald: 'We can guard the roads. We cannot put an army through that breach.'
Maya: 'Then stop calling the small party inadequate and start keeping its return road open.'
Nera: 'I have a list of everyone still missing.'
Player choices: 'Read it before we leave.' / 'Give each rescue team its names.'
Hald: 'Both. We have enough people to do both.'

Reserve companions take explicit evacuation, supply and protection assignments. Nobody is narratively discarded because the Xbox can simulate only a small active party.

scenes.title: The offer
scenes.staging: Morroc perimeter projection; Veyr, player.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: Come alone, and I will return the people you have lost.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: You do not know what they would choose.
I am not trading the living for a promise.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: You will let them disappear because you are afraid of the price.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: I am looking at the people you made pay it.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Veyr: 'Come alone, and I will return the people you have lost.'
Player choices: 'You do not know what they would choose.' / 'I am not trading the living for a promise.'
Veyr: 'You will let them disappear because you are afraid of the price.'
Player: 'I am looking at the people you made pay it.'

The offer is emotionally tempting without inventing a dead parent or tragic backstory for the player. It refers to witnessed losses; no companion is kidnapped merely to remove a support class's essential party member.

scenes.title: Three tasks, one return
scenes.staging: Breach staging room; active party, Witness, player.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: You reach the gate. We will keep you standing long enough to open it.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: I will bring them into the opening. Tell me when it is yours.

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: We will strike when you give the signal. Keep their names clear of the mechanism.

dialogue.speaker: Witness
text: If we cannot all return, do not make that decision before we have tried.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: We try together.
Nobody becomes the price of our victory.

scenes.fullSceneText:
V — Yuufa: 'You reach the gate. We will keep you standing long enough to open it.'
P — Roan: 'I will bring them into the opening. Tell me when it is yours.'
K — Takius: 'We will strike when you give the signal. Keep their names clear of the mechanism.'
Witness: 'If we cannot all return, do not make that decision before we have tried.'
Player choices: 'We try together.' / 'Nobody becomes the price of our victory.'

Playable sequence rescues captives, breaks a relay and secures an exit. Failure restarts the encounter checkpoint, not the entire campaign. Completion order varies by route; all objectives receive explicit feedback.

scenes.title: Before the last door
scenes.staging: Safe antechamber; route counterpart, player.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: I used to think being brave meant arriving first. You made me notice who was still outside.

dialogue.speaker: Takius
text: I used to think certainty would keep us safe. You taught me to keep asking when certainty became convenient.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: I used to think care meant never letting go. You helped me hear the difference between holding someone and holding them here.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: You helped me too.
Then let us finish this without forgetting it.

dialogue.speaker: Counterpart
text: Together.

scenes.fullSceneText:
V — Roan: 'I used to think being brave meant arriving first. You made me notice who was still outside.'
P — Takius: 'I used to think certainty would keep us safe. You taught me to keep asking when certainty became convenient.'
K — Yuufa: 'I used to think care meant never letting go. You helped me hear the difference between holding someone and holding them here.'
Player choices: 'You helped me too.' / 'Then let us finish this without forgetting it.'
Counterpart: 'Together.'

Offer save, rest, party adjustment and return to the world before the final commitment. Explain checkpoint/escape rules clearly.

scenes.title: The perfect archive
scenes.staging: Final anchor chamber; Veyr, Witness, player, active party.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: Look. Nothing lost. No forgotten graves. No children growing up without a face to remember.

dialogue.speaker: Witness
text: And no door that opens from the inside.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: You are alive because I refused to surrender you.

dialogue.speaker: Witness
text: You have not asked whether this is the life we want.

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: Open the archive.
Let them answer you.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: They are frightened. They do not understand what waits outside.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: That does not make their answer yours.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Veyr: 'Look. Nothing lost. No forgotten graves. No children growing up without a face to remember.'
Witness: 'And no door that opens from the inside.'
Veyr: 'You are alive because I refused to surrender you.'
Witness: 'You have not asked whether this is the life we want.'
Player choices: 'Open the archive.' / 'Let them answer you.'
Veyr: 'They are frightened. They do not understand what waits outside.'
Player: 'That does not make their answer yours.'

scenes.title: A voice he cannot overwrite
scenes.staging: Final encounter in three phases. Exact monster/model selection follows asset and solo-balance audit. Use an appropriate existing endgame threat for the ruptured Morroc manifestation rather than pretending a custom enemy already exists.

dialogue.speaker: Phase 1, Veyr
text: I will not lose them again!

dialogue.speaker: Party cue
text: Hold the manifestation away from the release gate!

dialogue.speaker: Party cue
text: The relay is exposed—break its channel!

dialogue.speaker: Party cue
text: The bindings are failing—guide the release while we cover you!

dialogue.speaker: Phase 2, Witness
text: Listen. These are our names. They are not your instructions.

dialogue.speaker: Phase 3, Veyr
text: If I let go, what will remain?

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: What they gave you. What you choose next.
Enough to begin making amends. Never enough to undo this.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: I do not know how.

dialogue.speaker: Player
text: Start by opening the door.

dialogue.speaker: After victory, Witness
text: Thank you for asking.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Phase 1, Veyr: 'I will not lose them again!'
V — Party cue: 'Hold the manifestation away from the release gate!'
P — Party cue: 'The relay is exposed—break its channel!'
K — Party cue: 'The bindings are failing—guide the release while we cover you!'
Phase 2, Witness: 'Listen. These are our names. They are not your instructions.'
Phase 3, Veyr: 'If I let go, what will remain?'
Player choices: 'What they gave you. What you choose next.' / 'Enough to begin making amends. Never enough to undo this.'
Veyr: 'I do not know how.'
Player: 'Start by opening the door.'
Veyr releases the emergency lock. The party still must defeat the manifestation; his one useful act does not erase his crimes.
After victory, Witness: 'Thank you for asking.'

All three routes participate in real combat. Support objectives use universal interactions plus ordinary support play, not mandatory Heal, Dispel or a class-specific spell. No route can win by waiting through an identical timer while NPCs do everything.

scenes.title: The ledger and the roof
scenes.staging: Prontera then guild hall; Nera, Hald, Veyr under guard, guild companions, player.

dialogue.speaker: Hald
text: The hearing will be public. The missing will have advocates. The records will have copies.

dialogue.speaker: Veyr
text: May I hear their names?

dialogue.speaker: Nera
text: When they choose to speak to you.

dialogue.speaker: At the hall, Maya
text: The roof survived. I dislike being surprised by competent workmanship.

dialogue.speaker: Judia
text: You paid for it.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
text: Yes. The rarest kind of competence.

dialogue.speaker: Yuufa
text: What will we call this in the record?

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: The names we kept.
The people who came home.

dialogue.speaker: Roan
text: And tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Player choices
text: We see who needs us.
We take a day off. Then we see who needs us.

scenes.fullSceneText:
Hald: 'The hearing will be public. The missing will have advocates. The records will have copies.'
Veyr: 'May I hear their names?'
Nera: 'When they choose to speak to you.'
At the hall, Maya: 'The roof survived. I dislike being surprised by competent workmanship.'
Judia: 'You paid for it.'
Maya: 'Yes. The rarest kind of competence.'
Yuufa: 'What will we call this in the record?'
Player choices: 'The names we kept.' / 'The people who came home.'
Roan: 'And tomorrow?'
Player choices: 'We see who needs us.' / 'We take a day off. Then we see who needs us.'

The final image is the open guild door and ordinary people arriving, not a declaration that all suffering has ended. Credits may run over quiet hall activity. Resume at a documented postgame point with travel, uncompleted side quests and optional endgame challenges available.
